subject.title: fix(tlon): bound outbound channel pokes with request timeout

question: Should Tlon outbound delivery adopt the same fixed 30-second wall-clock cutoff as the existing SSE-side poke path once real-ship proof is supplied?
rationale: A timeout fixes an indefinite hang but changes the delivery contract for slow ships and can make the result of an aborted poke ambiguous; repository history cannot establish the intended cutoff policy.

options.title: Approve 30 seconds after proof
options.body: Keep the shared fixed budget after a real-ship run shows normal delivery and controlled timeout behavior; this matches the existing sibling path and is recommended.

options.title: Choose another cutoff
options.body: Ask the Tlon owner to select a different fixed budget based on expected ship latency before the patch lands.

recommendation.title: Approve 30 seconds after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the shared fixed budget after a real-ship run shows normal delivery and controlled timeout behavior; this matches the existing sibling path and is recommended.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the introduction of Tlon outbound routing and adjacent plugin-boundary behavior.
